Class CacheAspectSupport

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.cache.interceptor.AbstractCacheInvoker
org.springframework.cache.interceptor.CacheAspectSupport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanFactoryAware, InitializingBean, SmartInitializingSingleton
Direct Known Subclasses:
CacheInterceptor
public abstract class CacheAspectSupport extends AbstractCacheInvoker implements BeanFactoryAware, InitializingBean, SmartInitializingSingleton
Base class for caching aspects, such as the CacheInterceptor or an AspectJ aspect.

这使得底层 Spring 缓存基础设施能够被轻松利用，以便为任何切面系统实现一个切面。

子类负责按正确顺序调用相关方法。

使用策略设计模式。CacheOperationSource用于确定缓存操作，KeyGenerator将构建缓存键，而CacheResolver将解析要使用的实际缓存。

注意：缓存切面是可序列化的，但在反序列化后不会执行任何实际的缓存操作。

Since:
3.1
Author:
Costin Leau, Juergen Hoeller, Chris Beams, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen, Stephane Nicoll, Sebastien Deleuze

  • 字段详情

    • IGNORE_REACTIVESTREAMS_PROPERTY_NAME

      public static final String IGNORE_REACTIVESTREAMS_PROPERTY_NAME
      System property that instructs Spring's caching infrastructure to ignore the presence of Reactive Streams, in particular Reactor's Mono/Flux in Cacheable method return type declarations.

      默认情况下，从 6.1 版本开始，Reactive Streams Publisher（例如 Reactor 的 `Mono`/`Flux`）将专门针对其生成的值进行异步缓存处理，而不是尝试缓存返回的 `Publisher` 实例本身。

      将此标志切换为 "true" 以忽略 Reactive Streams Publishers，并通过同步缓存将它们作为常规返回值进行处理，从而恢复 6.0 的行为。请注意，这并不推荐，且仅在非常有限的场景中有效，例如在使用手动 `Mono.cache()`/<`Flux.cache()`>调用时。

      Since:
      6.1.3
      See Also:
      • Publisher
      • Constant Field Values

    • afterPropertiesSet

      public void afterPropertiesSet()
      描述从接口复制：InitializingBean
      Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.

      此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

      Specified by:
      `afterPropertiesSet` 接口中的 `InitializingBean`

    • afterSingletonsInstantiated

      public void afterSingletonsInstantiated()
      描述从接口复制：SmartInitializingSingleton
      Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase, with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created already. ListableBeanFactory.getBeansOfType(Class) calls within this method won't trigger accidental side effects during bootstrap.

      注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

      Specified by:
      `afterSingletonsInstantiated` 接口 `SmartInitializingSingleton` 中
